# Editor Configuration Instructions

Parent: [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)

The repository maintainers own optional shared editor configuration here. `.vscode/extensions.json`
contains extension recommendations, and `.vscode/settings.json` contains workspace settings.

Relevant documentation: [`../docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md). Editor settings must remain
optional and must not replace repository build, lint, test, or formatting contracts.
